notifications.name: Lavine
notifications.danger: The fireworks may burst or release burning material too close to the ground, causing fire and/or burns and eye injuries to bystanders. Moreover, the product may not ignite correctly. A user may try to re-ignite it, with the risk of being hit by the pyrotechnic effects and thereby receive burns, damage to sight. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Pyrotechnics Directive nor with the European standard EN 15947-5.

notifications.danger: The product is highly flammable and contains benzyl salicylate (measured value 0.28% by weight). Benzyl salicylate can cause irritation and allergy reactions. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the classification, labelling and packaging of substances and mixtures (CLP).

notifications.name: Sonic - toothbrush for children
notifications.danger: The product has an excessive concentration of lead (measured values up to 55 % by weight).
